verdict.rationale: ZCode is an AI coding workbench with a terminal agent. Its marketing describes a Goal feature that plans, executes and verifies multi-step work, which glancingly touches the 'verify fixes' part of the story. No evidence covers reproducing bugs or narrowing down root causes; the screenshot-understanding claim is only tangentially related. Missing for 10: documented issue-reproduction workflow, root-cause analysis or debugging tooling (e.g. running tests or debuggers, log or stack-trace inspection), concrete fix-verification mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging use.
